topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series structure, welcomes students from different degree backgrounds, and outlines the session's core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cellular and Developmental Origins of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore cancer as a multistep disease driven by accumulated genetic alterations that disrupt normal cellular differentiation, tissue architecture, and developmental programs.

topics.label: Benign versus Malignant Tumors: Invasion, Progression, and Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how benign and malignant tumors are distinguished by invasive behavior and histological progression, and outline the standard nomenclature used to classify them.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical and physiological mechanisms through which local tumor growth and distant metastases cause illness and death.

topics.label: Patterns of Cancer Incidence Across Tissues and Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer incidence and mortality vary across human organ systems and compare these patterns across diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Cancer Screening and Early Detection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale for early cancer detection and the varying effectiveness of screening approaches across different tumor types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by referencing the learning outcomes and previewing the upcoming practical sessions.
